Where they come from

Rugs from three traditions

  1. AsiaOriental designs, fine detail and deep colour.
  2. SyriaClassic medallions and borders for traditional rooms.
  3. TurkeyVintage washes and modern designs, in every size.

Asian, Turkish and Syrian rugs next to classic Persian-style medallions, Scandinavian plains, jute from the sun and faux fur for the winter. Whatever the style of your home, there is a rug that suits it.

  • Classic & oriental
  • Modern & plain
  • Shaggy & faux fur
  • Straw, jute, all season
  • Round, oval, kids’
  • Runners, mats, sets

Service
In-store shopping, pick-up, delivery
Is the “2 rugs for €50” offer real?

Yes. In the shop at Mesogeion Ave 356 you can take two rugs for €50. Ask us which designs and sizes are in the offer today — it changes with the stock.

How much does a runner by the metre cost?

From €8 to €15 per metre, depending on the width and the design. We have three widths: 0.60, 0.80 and 1.00 metres.

Can you cut a runner to the length I need?

Yes. Runners are sold by the metre, so we cut them to your hallway. Bring the measurement with you or call us first.

Are you open on Sundays?

Yes, from October to December we are open on Sundays from 10:00 to 17:00. Monday to Saturday we are open from 9:00 to 21:00.

Do you deliver?

Yes, we deliver. Call us and tell us the area and the rugs you chose. You can also pick them up from the shop yourself.

What kinds of rugs do you have?

Round, oval, kids’, shaggy, faux fur, plain, straw and jute, all-season, Asian, Turkish and Syrian, classic and modern rugs, as well as runners, mats and bedroom sets.

What size of rug do I need for the living room?

Usually 160×230 or 200×290 cm: the front legs of the sofa and armchairs should rest on the rug. Measure the space and bring a photo — we will help you choose.

Can I ask about a design I saw on the website?

Of course. Tap “Ask about it” on the rug, call us or send us the design name on Viber and we will tell you if it is in stock and in which sizes.
